title: UNIT FOUR: POLITICS, ECONOMY AND SOCIETY FROM THE LATE THIRTEENTH TO THE BEGINNING OF THE SIXTEENTH CENTURIES
content:
ሰላም፣ ጤና ይስጥልኝ ውድና የተከበራችሁ የEthioFresh አባላትና ትልቁ ቤተሰቦቻችን! ❤️✨ እንኳን ወደ History of Ethiopia and the Horn (Hist. 1012) Unit 4 Part 1 Tutorial በደስታ እና በፍቅር በሰላም መጣችሁ! ዛሬም የካምፓስ ፈተናችሁን 100% በብቃት እንድታልፉ የሚያስችላችሁን አጠቃላይ የሞጁሉን ሀሳብ መስመር በመስመር በዝርዝርና በምሳሌዎች አዘጋጅተንላችኋል። መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ይሁንላችሁ👇👇👇! 🚀

4.1. The "Restoration" of the "Solomonid" Dynasty

• Overthrow of Zagwe Dynasty (1270): The Zagwe dynasty was overthrown in 1270 AD by Yekunno-Amlak, a contender from Amhara. Yekunno-Amlak launched military campaigns from Lasta to Gayint and ultimately defeated Yetharek, the last Zagwe king.
• Weakness of Zagwe Rulers: Relative political and military quietness left the Zagwe rulers unable to resist Yekunno-Amlak's expanding military power base in Shewa. Shewa grew rich by diverting trade routes away from traditional paths through Lasta.
• Ideological Narrative & Kibre Negest: The "Solomonids" portrayed Zagwe rulers as "usurpers" of the royal throne of Aksum, despite Zagwe's promotion of Christianity and Aksumite secular culture. The Kibre Negest ("The Glory of the Kings"), the foundational myth of the Christian kingdom, claimed Ethiopian rulers descended from King Solomon and the Queen of Sheba. This narrative delegitimized Zagwe, legitimizing the new dynasty and binding Ethiopia to Judeo-Christian traditions starting with Yekunno-Amlak (r. 1270–1285).

👉
1. የዛጉዌ ሥልጣነ-መንግሥት መውደቅ (1270 AD): በ1270 ዓ.ም ከአማራ የተነሳው ይኩኖ-አምላክ ከላስታ እስከ ጋይንት ባካሄደው ዘመቻ የመጀመሪያውና የመጨረሻውን የዛጉዌ ንጉሥ ይትባረክን በማሸነፍ የዛጉዌን ሥልጣን አበቃለት። ዛጉዌዎች የወደቁት የንግድ መስመር በሸዋ በኩል እንዲዞር ስለተደረገና በወታደራዊ ኃይል ስለተዳከሙ ነው።
2. የሶሎሞናዊ ሥወረ-መንግሥት ርዕዮተ-ዓለም እና ክፍለ-ታሪክ (Kibre Negest): የዛጉዌ ነገሥታት ክርስቲያናዊና የአክሱምን ባህል ቢያስፋፉም፣ አዲሶቹ ገዢዎች የዛጉዌን ሥልጣን "ቀማኞች/Usurpers" በማለት ፈረጇቸው። ክብረ ነገሥት በተባለው መጽሐፍ አማካኝነት የኢትዮጵያ ነገሥታት ከንጉሥ ሰሎሞን እና ከንግሥተ ሳባ የተወለዱ ናቸው የሚል ትረካ በመፍጠር የይኩኖ-አምላክን (1270-1285) ሥልጣን ሕጋዊ እና ከይሁዳ-ክርስቲያን ባህል ጋር የተያያዘ አደረጉት።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Year of Zagwe Overthrow: 1270 AD by Yekunno-Amlak.
• Last King of Zagwe Dynasty: Yetharek.
• Foundational Legal/Ideological Text: Kibre Negest ("The Glory of the Kings").
• Main Economic Base for Yekunno-Amlak: Trade route diversion through Shewa.

😂 ቀልድ ላፍታ: የ"ክብረ ነገሥት" ጸሐፊዎች የዛጉዌን ነገሥታት "Usurpers" (ቀማኞች) ያሏቸው እኮ ዛሬ በሶሻል ሚዲያ ያልተፈለገ ሰው ሲመጣ "Fake Account" ብሎ Unfollow እንደማድረግ ይቆጠራል! 😜


4.2. Internal Political Conflict

• Formative Vexing Challenges: Early years of the dynasty faced two major problems: establishing a consistent modality of succession to the throne, and formulating an effective policy for regulating Christian-Muslim relations.
• Polygamy and Succession Crises: Emperors practiced polygamy and arranged political marriages with tributary kings and provincial nobility, leading to intense royal succession intrigues. Major succession crises erupted after Yekunno-Amlak's death (1285) and during the reign of Yegba-Tsion (r. 1285–1294).
• The Royal Prison of Amba Gishen: To prevent continuous power struggles, a royal prison was established at Amba Gishen in Wollo, commissioned by Emperor Widim-Ra'ad (r. 1299–1314). This flat-topped mountain fortress with a heavily guarded single entrance served as a residence where all male heirs, princes, and royal relatives were sequestered. By the mid-15th century, 590 royal descendants were kept there with amenities until Imam Ahmed ibn Ibrahim's army destroyed it in 1540.

👉
1. የውስጥ የሥልጣን ሽኩቻና ተፎካካሪነት: የሥልጣን ተካኪነትን ለመወሰንና ከሙስሊም ሱልጣኔቶች ጋር የነበረውን ግንኙነት ለመምራት ግልጽ መመሪያ አልነበረም። ነገሥታቱ ብዙ ሚስት ማግባታቸው (Polygamy) እና ከየብሔረሰቡ መሳፍንት ጋር የሚያደርጉት የፖለቲካ ጋብቻ በልጆቻቸው መካከል ለሥልጣን የሚደረገውን ሴራና ውጊያ አበዛው።
2. የአምባ ግሸን ንጉሣዊ እስር ቤት (Amba Gishen): የሥልጣን ሺኩቻውን ለማስቆም በንጉሥ ውድም-ራዕድ (1299-1314) ትዕዛዝ በወሎ የሚገኘው አምባ ግሸን ንጉሣዊ እስር ቤት ሆነ። በወታደር የሚጠበቅ አንድ መግቢያ ያለው ይህ አምባ የንጉሥ ወንድ ልጆችና የሥልጣን ተፎካካሪዎች የሚታሰሩበት ቦታ ነበር። በ15ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን 590 የንጉሥ ዘሮች ታስረውበት የነበረ ሲሆን በ1540 በአሕመድ ግራኝ ጦር እስከወደመበት ጊዜ ድረስ አገልግሏል።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Establishment of Amba Gishen Royal Prison: Commissioned by Emperor Widim-Ra'ad (r. 1299–1314).
• Purpose of Amba Gishen: To sequester potential royal succession heirs and prevent power struggles.
• Destruction of Amba Gishen: Fell to Imam Ahmed ibn Ibrahim's (Gragn Ahmed) army in 1540.

😂 የአምባ ግሸን ታሳሪዎች እኮ በዓለም ታሪክ ውስጥ ቅንጡ ከተባሉት ታሳሪዎች መካከል ነበሩ፤ ምግብና አልባሳት ይቀርብላቸዋል ነገር ግን WiFi የለውም (ከቤተመንግሥት ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት የላቸውም)! 😅


4.3. Power Consolidation and Spatial Extension

• Territorial Status by 1270: When Yekunno-Amlak ascended the throne, the Christian kingdom covered Eritrea, northern, northwestern, and central Ethiopia. However, areas east of the Shewan plateau (Ifat and Hadiya), the kingdom of Ethiopian Jews (Beta Israel), Gojjam, Damot, and coastal Muslim principalities (from Dahlak to Brava) were outside central control.
• Reign of Emperor Amde-Tsion (r. 1314–1344): Embarked on solidifying Solomonid power in Christian provinces and conquering external political units. Suppressed internal revolts by northern governors in Enderta, reorganizing rebellious provinces into smaller, easily governable units under trusted governors and imperial garrisons.
• Rapid Expansion Campaigns: Conquered Damot and Hadiya (1316–1317). Expanded sphere of influence to Gibe, Gojeb, and Omo river basins, and annexed Gojjam and Lake Tana region. Asserted authority over Muslim communities along trade routes from Gulf of Aden to Awash valley (Ifat, Dawaro, Sharkha, Bali) into tribute-paying vassalage.
• Historical Significance: Arab historian Ibn Fadil al-Omari described Amde-Tsion as having "ninety-nine kings under him, and that he makes up the hundredth". Expansion was driven by "terrain and trade" (seizing new lands and controlling lucrative Muslim-dominated trade routes), creating a multi-ethnic, multi-linguistic, and religious kingdom.

👉
1. የዓምደ-ጽዮን ግዛት ማስፋፋትና ማጠናከር (1314–1344): አፄ ዓምደ-ጽዮን በወታደራዊ ጥበባቸው የሚታወቁ ሲሆን በመጀመሪያ የኢንደርታን (Enderta) የውስጥ አመጽ በማስቆም ግዛቱን ለአስተዳደር በሚመቹ ትንንሽ ክፍሎች ከፈሉት።
2. ታላቁ የደቡብና የምሥራቅ ዘመቻ: በ1316-1317 ዳሞትንና ሀዲያን ተቆጣጠሩ። በመቀጠልም እስከ ጊቤ፣ ጎጀብ፣ ኦሞ ወንዞች እንዲሁም ጎጃምና ጣና ዙሪያን ጠቀለሉ። በምሥራቅ በኩል የንግድ መስመሮችን ለመቆጣጠር ይፋት፣ ዳዋሮ፣ ሻርካ እና ባሌን ግብር ገባሪ አደረጉ።
3. የዓረቡ የታሪክ ጸሐፊ ምስክርነት: ኢብን ፋድል አል-ዑመሪ (Ibn Fadil al-Omari) ዓምደ-ጽዮንን "99 ነገሥታትን በሥሩ የሚያስተዳድር 100ኛው ንጉሥ ነው" ሲል ገልጾታል። ዋነኛ ዓላማቸው መሬትና የንግድ መስመሮችን (Terrain and Trade) መቆጣጠር ነበር።

💡 Exam Hints:
• Emperor Famous for Rapid Medieval Territorial Expansion: Emperor Amde-Tsion (r. 1314–1344).
• Primary Motivations of Solomonid Expansion: Seizing terrain and controlling lucrative trade routes ("Terrain and Trade").
• Famous Quote by Ibn Fadil al-Omari: Described Amde-Tsion as having 99 kings under him.
• Years of Damot and Hadiya Conquest: 1316–1317 AD.
